confirmation_rule: Two highest-ranked complete candidates per method plus that method's original incumbent, deduplicated; repeat on full bank before choosing winners.

data_subset_manifest.sampling: 64 whole episodes uniformly without replacement; original order retained

scope: Screening bank subset; full-bank confirmation and final evaluation; no parameter changes using final test results.
runtime_note: Six single-threaded workers on physical cores1–6 of L3group0, low priority. Timing core15/sibling31 and their whole L3group1 are excluded; monitor23/core7 remains free. Shared memory and package power are not isolated.
